text: Hey, man. Don't you ever have to go to work?
I guess management finally figured out that guys getting murdered in the office is bad for productivity.
So you like having bad dreams about that dead guy or what?
I'm having bad dreams about everything else.
You know, when my hamster Louie died,
I'd have these nightmares where he'd come in through my window at night,
only he was, like, the size of a pit bull,
and he'd be drooling and he'd be singing,
Scared the hell out of me, man.
